reason: The indexed metric and a plausible C-centered Z=8 cell are supported, but the submitted exact Cmm2 realization is not sufficiently established. No comparable whole-pattern Rwp was supplied, and the final diffraction check only showed that observed peak positions lie near calculated lines; it did not establish the observed intensities/profile, submitted symmetry, coordinates, or element ordering. More decisively, the expanded CIF is physically inadmissible, with O-O contacts near 1.149 A, P-O bonds near 1.213 A, Li-Li nearest contacts near 1.600 A, and Co-F contacts near 1.634 A. The trace explored several symmetry models but did not obtain a chemically valid, quantitatively superior refinement or retain alternatives. A materially different chemistry-constrained structure could therefore plausibly improve the candidate set, so another solution attempt is warranted.
